players.product: Power and distribution transformers and substations (T&D) for grid connection, plus Marathon alternators for data-center energy backup and industrial pumps / ventilation equipment for cooling systems

quarterly_data.signal: Santa Lucia Mill (Araras, Sao Paulo) replaced its traditional torque-split milling drives with six WEG planetary gearboxes, operating alongside its existing steam turbines; the mill's milling coordinator says the new drives' efficiency is approximately 15% higher than the traditional systems, and the mill may later replace the turbines with electric motors.
